environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in a public subnet with an internet-facing ALB. The Step Functions API is accessed via the public AWS endpoint (states.us-east-1.amazonaws.com). The ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to the container on port 3000 with no request filtering. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The service uses IAM task role with states:StartExecution and states:DescribeExecution permissions.
